svg.title: Black White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Two identically shaped triangular canvases confirmed by the Met description and ordinary preview; shared vertical edge preserved. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/915129; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
